evidence: Heavily modifies src/node/blockstorage.cpp (+194/-24) and blockstorage.h to implement resumable block file reobfuscation.
rationale: Adds built-in tooling to reobfuscate raw block and undo files to mitigate antivirus quarantine risks without redownloading the chain. The problem is real and addresses a user operational pain point, but it is reasonably deferrable since operators can continue running as-is or resync.
